column1: -- ── Shared poster: reverse nothing, just post the receipt's journal(s) from
--    the current NEW row. Used by INSERT and by the UPDATE repost path. ──
-- (inlined below rather than a sub-function to keep this self-contained)
IF COALESCE(NEW.is_deleted, FALSE) THEN RETURN NEW
IF NEW.receipt_type = 'booking' AND NEW.tenant_allotment_id IS NOT NULL THEN
IF COALESCE(NEW.is_deleted, FALSE) AND NOT COALESCE(OLD.is_deleted, FALSE) THEN
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries r WHERE r.is_reversal_of=je.id)
-- 2) Live row: repost when a journal-affecting field changed, or when the
--    row is being restored from soft-deleted.
OR NEW.amount_paid       IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.amount_paid
OR NEW.payment_date      IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payment_date
OR NEW.payment_mode      IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payment_mode
OR NEW.bank_account_id   IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.bank_account_id
OR NEW.receipt_type      IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.receipt_type
OR NEW.tenant_id         IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.tenant_id
OR NEW.tenant_allotment_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.tenant_allotment_id
OR NEW.receipt_number    IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.receipt_number
-- Reverse the receipt's existing live journal entries...
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries r WHERE r.is_reversal_of=je.id)
-- ...then re-post fresh from the new values (mirrors the INSERT path).
IF NEW.receipt_type = 'booking' AND NEW.tenant_allotment_id IS NOT NULL THEN
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries r WHERE r.is_reversal_of=je.id)
